topics.body:
# Terminals

This bundled manifest-only plugin declares the chords terminal emulators bind for Flash's built-in actions. `pane_next` / `pane_previous` (`]p` / `[p` when mapped) send Cmd-] / Cmd-[ in Ghostty and iTerm2 when no tmux client hosts the focused terminal; tmux still owns its panes first.
